findings.description: Design D2 and the roadmap-orchestration spec correctly distinguish hard-invalid checkpoint state (which withholds workspace items and external completion refs) from soft roadmap/checkpoint terminal-status divergence (which emits a stale diagnostic, but keeps the workspace resolvable and preserves checkpoint-authoritative readiness and external completion).
findings.resolution: Verified design.md (D2, D5) and specs/roadmap-orchestration/spec.md scenarios for invalid checkpoints and terminal state overrides; no changes needed.

findings.description: The readiness result contract schema in readiness-result.schema.json includes diagnostic enum codes roadmap_invalid and duplicate_roadmap_id, matching the D5 CLI boundary specification for malformed roadmaps and duplicate declared roadmap IDs.
findings.resolution: Verified contracts/readiness-result.schema.json diagnostic code enum additions; no changes needed.

findings.description: Design D3 completely specifies the source_fingerprint projection schema, canonical key and list sorting, compact JSON separators, trailing newline, absent-checkpoint sentinel, and raw-byte SHA-256 fallback for malformed files, ensuring byte-stable output without relying on timestamps or mtimes.
findings.resolution: Verified design.md D3 specification and spec.md Deterministic Readiness Projection requirements; no changes needed.

findings.description: The round 1 remediations are fully consistent with the normative checkpoint override scenario in spec.md, task coverage in tasks.md (tasks 2.1 and 2.2), and single-package scope in work-packages.yaml (wp-readiness-runtime).
findings.resolution: Verified alignment across spec.md, tasks.md, and work-packages.yaml; no changes needed.
